cohort: The study included preterm infants born at < 34 gestational weeks whose urine was longitudinally collected.
finding: The urinary metabolome is closely associated with underlying GI disease from birth, with early urinary metabolic features showing potential to predict surgical NEC and differentiate NEC patients from healthy controls.
cross-section timing: Urine samples were collected at birth (< 48 h, T0), 14 days (T1), and 28 days (T2).
